source: NOAA/NWS Storm Prediction Center — SPC Severe Weather Database (1950–present tornado tracks), via www.spc.noaa.gov/wcm

field_notes.om: SPC event id (unique within a year)
field_notes.min: minutes after midnight, local standard time (-1 if unknown)
field_notes.fc: 1 if mag was estimated later from an originally-unknown (-9) rating
field_notes.loss: property loss; methodology changed in 1996 (categorical->dollars) - treat as approximate
field_notes.closs: crop loss; same caveat as loss
field_notes.slat/slon/elat/elon: start/end coordinates in decimal degrees; end==start if no distinct endpoint was recorded
